caption: The video captures a tight, eye-level close-up of a painted metal railing above a pale ledge, with a small translucent dome-shaped droplet resting at the center in front of the bars. A vertical bar crosses the upper middle and a thicker flared post stands to the right of the droplet, both holding steady positions relative to the frame edges. The droplet keeps the same rounded size and shape from first to last frame, its thin glossy film spreading at the base without visibly sliding or vanishing. The heavily out-of-focus background shows dark green foliage with bright circular bokeh on the left and a soft pinkish wall on the right. Across the excerpt these blurred highlights flicker and shift in shape and brightness, and the indistinct leaves behind the railing move slightly, indicating change in the backdrop rather than camera travel. The horizontal bar, vertical bar, right post, and ledge remain fixed, so the foreground stays locked off while the soft background shimmer continues. No dripping or movement of the railing or droplet is observed, and the flare at the post's base stays a static feature.
